title: Behavioural test: source-root naming cannot replace a retained non-admission bind, and consider proactive recovery
outcome: A test with a base-only session that has no routing token leaves a non-admission session_bind unresolved, then attempts source-root naming. It asserts a conflict, zero competing SessionBind calls, and an unchanged retained request and key. After the retained bind is settled, naming proceeds. The item also decides, with the coordinator, whether a naming request should trigger recovery of the retained original instead of waiting for the session's next bind.
acceptance: Behavioural test: source-root naming cannot replace a retained non-admission bind, and consider proactive recovery is done
